content.short: A Community Integration Suite for Blockchain-based projects to secure, reward and engage with their people.
content.description:
Built on the three core tenets of Security, Privacy and User Experience, Vibrant is a web platform and API-based solution to allow projects a plethora of community-based features for Discord, Twitter and other social media platforms and messaging apps.

Among those features you will find scam-protection mechanisms, advanced token-gating in Discord, Whitelists, off-chain polling as well as integrations with well known on-chain polling solutions. It is also easy to create mint- and marketplace trackers that keep your community updated about on-chain activity. Cardano-specific features like epoch reminders, epoch counters and wallet-verification flows round out the offering for projects. With our unique ping feature, anyone on a Vibrant-enabled server can send messages to a wallet address and the recipient can safely read the message in Discord, without any wallet information being exposed to the sender.

Our focus on User Experience means that everything is built with the ability to self-service and have a smooth experience while managing their community. Our extensive documentation and personal support offering will ensure no one is left with questions when they need to find an answer.

DAOs, DeFi solutions and NFT projects alike can benefit from the social media and instant messaging bridge "Vibrant".
